title: AttestationDocument
description: A claim (SEP §7.3) that a deployed contract emits a given SEP-48-shaped event schema. Exists for contracts deployed before SEP-48/CAP-67, which have no embedded contract spec this could otherwise be derived from. Signature-envelope concerns (who signed it, tamper detection) are a separate layer - see SEP §7.4.

contractId.description: Bech32-encoded Soroban contract address (C…) the attestation is about.

wasmHash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the attested contract's deployed WASM bytecode.

events.description: The SEP-48-shaped event definitions being attested to.

attester.description: Stellar account address (G…) of the party making this attestation. Must match the signing key in the SEP §7.4 envelope wrapping this document.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the attestation was made.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the attestation should no longer be trusted.

supersedes.description: Hex-encoded hash of a prior attestation document this one supersedes.

PrimitiveType.description: An atomic Soroban scalar type. Mirrors `schema/spec.schema.json`'s definition of the same name.

BytesNType.description: A fixed-length byte array, e.g. bytes_n<32>.

OptionType.description: A Soroban Option<T> - a value that may be present or absent.

ResultType.description: A Soroban Result<T, E> - either Ok(T) or Err(E).

TupleType.description: A fixed-length heterogeneous sequence (Soroban Tuple). Minimum 2 elements.

NamedType.description: A reference to a user-defined type declared in the attested contract's own ContractSpec.types.

TypeSpec.description: Union of every representable Soroban type. Either a primitive string literal or a tagged-object composite type.

FieldSpec.description: A named, typed field used in an event's topics or data.

EventSpec.description: Specification of one event the attested contract emits via env.events().publish().

topics.description: Ordered topic ScVal descriptors. The first topic is conventionally the event-name Symbol.

data.description: Ordered payload data fields emitted alongside the topics.
